vopros: What is Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions in Tampa, and what do they do?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions, LLC is a Tampa, Florida-based financial-services firm. Florida corporate records show it was formed in November 2021 and remains active as of its March 18, 2026 annual report. Julia Dospehoff is listed as its manager and registered agent. ([search.sunbiz.org](https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/GetDocument?aggregateId=flal-l21000488130-2e624945-25aa-449f-880a-4bfffb23ecbb&formatType=PDF&transactionId=l21000488130-a17b9744-6e6b-4621-89f9-f0f2d6471403&utm_source=openai))

The company appears to provide outsourced accounting and CFO-level support—essentially giving businesses access to financial-management expertise without employing a full-time CFO or maintaining a full internal accounting department. However, I couldn't locate an authoritative company website or detailed public service catalog, so I wouldn't attribute a specific menu of services to them without further verification.

In this type of business, the work typically includes bookkeeping/accounting oversight, financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash-flow management, financial analysis, and strategic CFO advice. That's the distinction behind "CFO & Accounting": accounting handles accurate financial records and reporting, while CFO services use those numbers for planning, decision-making, profitability analysis, and growth strategy. Comparable fractional-CFO firms describe their work in those terms. ([ascentcfo.com](https://ascentcfo.com/services/virtual-cfo-services/?utm_source=openai))

The registered principal address is 10139 Heather Sound Drive, Tampa, FL 33647. The LLC's Florida document number is L21000488130. ([search.sunbiz.org](https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/GetDocument?aggregateId=flal-l21000488130-2e624945-25aa-449f-880a-4bfffb23ecbb&formatType=PDF&transactionId=l21000488130-a17b9744-6e6b-4621-89f9-f0f2d6471403&utm_source=openai))
